# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.86

This release simplifies the mobile light saber controls.

## Improved

- Replaced the large light saber HUD panel with one compact sword icon beside
  the Run button.
- The icon toggles the equipped light saber on and off without covering the
  gameplay controls.
- Light saber colour selection remains available through the shop.
- Added compact-phone spacing so the saber, Run, Interact, Jump, and Emote
  controls remain separate on narrow screens.

## Android updates

- Uses the production package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline`.
- Uses the same signing certificate as v1.5.79, v1.5.84, and v1.5.85, allowing
  a normal in-place update.

## Included files

- `BlockBuddies-Offline-v1.5.86.apk`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
- `SIGNING-CERTIFICATE.txt`
- `APK-BADGING.txt`

## Validation

- Exact v1.5.79 signer-certificate check
- Package-name and app-label checks
- ESLint and Oxlint
- TypeScript type checking
- Vitest unit and component tests
- Mobile layout checks at 576x1024 and 320x568
- Production web build
- Capacitor Android sync and release APK assembly
